contract: Owner-worker exclusive success-only handoff of OPEN native TCP or ownership-certified native OPEN client TLS, optional owned read-ahead. Caller already validates HTTP Upgrade and selected mqtt; host configures peer trust. Factory checks native state/role and exact metadata, not historical HTTP/trust decisions. False consumes neither native/Initial nor output. CONNECT/config/auth snapshots before publication; post-handoff failures use typed Ready/close. No cleartext fallback.
implementation: One original Client parser/QoS/subscription/alias/Auth/Session/Inbox engine. Binary bytes cross arbitrary WS message/frame boundaries; Text rejected. Read callback copies directly into existing input within read/packet work budgets; only unread suffix stages into bounded/wiped/reusable storage. Native frame allocation/masking/copies and TLS plaintext/ciphertext processing remain real. First gather span per Binary frame avoids flattening but costs extra frames/allocations. Existing admission/result copies remain. No claim of zero copy, zero allocation or complete high-performance qualification.
ownership: Generic 24-byte aligned request fence tail reuses direct TLS layout. WSS waits out unsent staged output before capturing the final native ciphertext cut; prior cuts remain observable. Valid UINT64_MAX uses explicit Awaiting identity rather than a sentinel collision. Early ACK may resolve while actual request/id/quota/native credits remain held. Existing post/task/timer performs bounded work and 5ms physical-retirement retries. Real WS retirement and root destruction precede Client owned-data retirement; native aliases block Wait, owned TLS original configuration remains retained. Engine/code join remains host responsibility.
